name: Never to Return: The Destroyed and the Vanished
description: Wonders of the ancient world, burned libraries, dead languages, razed cities and a bridge in Bosnia: the things people made and then lost for good, and how they went.

checkpoints.name: The ancient world
checkpoints.note: Sumerian and later Etruscan fade from speech, Babylon and its Hanging Gardens decay, the Library of Ashurbanipal is buried when Nineveh falls in 612 BCE, and Rome razes Carthage. The Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, the Statue of Zeus at Olympia and the Colossus of Rhodes are built as wonders; the Colossus falls in an earthquake within a lifetime.

checkpoints.name: Wonders fall
checkpoints.note: Pompeii lies under ash in 79, the Library of Alexandria fades, and the Temple of Artemis and the Lighthouse of Alexandria fall. Nalanda and Baghdad's House of Wisdom are destroyed by invaders, Cahokia empties, Spanish conquerors raze Tenochtitlan in 1521 and the Roanoke colony vanishes. The Buddhas of Bamiyan, carved in the 6th century, still stand.

checkpoints.name: Fire and glass
checkpoints.note: The Globe Theatre closes in 1642 and is soon pulled down, the Great Fire of London burns most of the old city in 1666, and the Amber Room is carried from Prussia to Russia. In 1851 London builds the Crystal Palace of iron and glass, while the painting The Storm on the Sea of Galilee passes between collectors.

checkpoints.name: Twentieth-century losses
checkpoints.note: Fire destroys the Crystal Palace in 1936 and the airship Hindenburg in 1937, and the Amber Room vanishes in the Second World War. The last native speaker of Manx dies in 1974, Pripyat is abandoned after the 1986 reactor disaster, the Berlin Wall falls, The Storm on the Sea of Galilee is stolen in Boston in 1990 and the Stari Most bridge is shelled down in 1993.

checkpoints.name: The new century
checkpoints.note: The twin towers of the World Trade Center fall in 2001, the Taliban blow up the Buddhas of Bamiyan the same year, and the Antonov An-225 Mriya, the largest aircraft ever flown, is destroyed at its airfield near Kyiv in 2022.
